chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-‘Ala’ and Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام:

Concerning two men who testified against an absent man before his wife that he had divorced her, so the woman observed her waiting period and married. Then the absent husband returned and claimed that he had not divorced her, and one of the two witnesses declared himself to have been false.

He عليه السلام said: "The latter husband has no claim over her, and the dowry is taken from the one who testified and then retracted, and it is returned to the latter husband. They are to be separated, and she must observe a waiting period from the latter husband, and the first husband must not approach her until her waiting period is completed."

key_terms.الصَّدَاقُ: the marriage dower owed in the case
key_terms.تَعْتَدُّ: she must observe a waiting period
key_terms.يُفَرَّقُ: separation is enforced between the spouses

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman remarries after false testimony of divorce and a witness later retracts?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about false testimony in a marital case where a woman remarries based on witnesses' claim of divorce. When one witness retracts, the second marriage is dissolved, financial liability falls on the retracting witness, and the woman must complete her 'iddah before returning to the first husband.
